title: Five physics closures and three outside-box probes: gauge-string fractional pumping, an active Floquet-Bogoliubov horizon, dynamically selected spectral dimension, a local scar compiler, thermodynamic curvature, qutrit holonomy memory, transport speed limits, and spectral redshift
purpose: Execute the five physics targets following Passes 4097-4104 and add three independent outside-box constructions with exact finite-model checks and strict evidence boundaries.
result: The one-third-filled pump was tensored with the unique finite SU(3) Gauss singlet, proving that matter and attached flux move together while net color charge vanishes and the zero-flux three-cycle Wilson holonomy is identity. A directed Floquet walk plus BdG squeezing produced an exact six-channel paraunitary horizon cell with thermal occupation, greybody loss, partner entanglement, and lattice UV corrections. A four-channel information-balance Lyapunov flow selected b=80^(1/4) and spectral dimension four as a stable fixed point. A Hamming-support no-go ruled out direct static finite-range cycling of the bare CDW trio, while an eight-pulse nearest-neighbor Floquet SWAP compiler gave exact three-cycle revival. The two-parameter dark-reservoir Fisher curvature changed sign without a finite thermodynamic singularity. Three outside-box probes produced qutrit projective holonomy, an exact branch-shift quantum speed limit, and a discrete spectral-redshift law.
coordination: Passes 4005-4112, the repaired single-publisher master:/docs Pages contract, the authoritative long-form docs/index.html, and the ordered manuscript frontier remain intact. This packet does not edit docs/index.html directly.
boundary: Exact finite Gauss-law, paraunitary-scattering, gradient-flow, local-circuit, finite information-geometry, projective-holonomy, unitary-geodesic, and hierarchy-scaling statements only.
